news.title: Crizac takes 37% stake in ForeignAdmits
news.summary_en: The deal marks Crizac's latest move beyond student recruitment as it expands into education finance and visa preparation services.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Irish ELT providers hail new rules for language students moving to HE
news.summary_en: ELT providers in Ireland have welcomed a new measure that lets eligible international students stay in the country between completing an English language program and progressing to higher education.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: From civic universities to civil universities
news.summary_en: In her June edition of Beech-side Views, Diana Beech reflects on the role of universities in rebuilding trust in a divided political landscape.
news.author: Diana Beech

news.title: British Council moots axing 25% of workforce to pay off pandemic loan
news.summary_en: The British Council is considering further layoffs to help pay off a £197 million government bailout, an investigation from the National Audit Office (NAO) has revealed.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: QS rankings: US loses ground on research and talent attraction
news.summary_en: While America remains the frontrunner on graduate employability, its universities are losing ground to rivals in China and beyond as the research gap and international talent race tighten.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: India’s university rise broadens beyond IITs, but internationalisation lags
news.summary_en: More than half of India's ranked universities improved their position in the QS World University Rankings 2027, with 18 institutions reaching record highs as gains spread beyond the IITs despite persistent internationalisation challenges.
news.author: Abhishek Nair
